frames.text: A minimalist black and white composition showing two separate black ink formations against a pure white background. At the top of the frame, a small irregular black ink blob appears to be dripping or falling downward. At the bottom of the frame, another black ink formation with a fuzzy, brush-like texture sits at the edge. The vertical 9:16 portrait orientation creates significant negative white space between the two elements, suggesting the beginning of ink dispersing in liquid.

The black ink has dramatically expanded to fill most of the frame, creating a large, organic cloud-like formation against the white background. The ink displays characteristic fluid dynamics with billowing, rounded edges and varying densities - darker concentrated areas in the center with more translucent, wispy tendrils extending outward on both sides. The shape is roughly symmetrical and vertical, resembling smoke or ink dispersing in water, with the white background visible only at the edges.

The black ink cloud has continued to expand and diffuse, now occupying nearly the entire frame with only small portions of white visible at the top corners and edges. The ink formation shows more dispersed, smoky tendrils around its perimeter, with the center remaining densely black. The edges have become more feathered and ethereal, displaying the characteristic swirling patterns of ink or dye mixing in liquid. The composition is almost entirely dominated by the dark mass.
